label.purpose: Mono uppercase status chips and data columns.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Primary action button across all headers and modal forms.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #4f46e5; color: #ffffff; padding: 8px 16px; font-weight: 600; font-size: 13px; border: none; border-radius: 8px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s, transform 0.15s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #4338ca; transform: translateY(-1px); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Secondary control button for date filtering and auxiliary actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: #ffffff; color: #0f172a; padding: 8px 16px; font-weight: 500; font-size: 13px; border: 1px solid #e2e8f0; border-radius: 8px; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 0.15s; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { border-color: #cbd5e1; }

components.name: Compliance Badge
components.description: Status chip indicating compliance percentage or completion state.
components.css: .ds-badge-green { background: #f0fdf4; color: #16a34a; padding: 4px 10px; border-radius: 6px; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 800; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; }

narrative.overview: SociHR fuses the rigor of an enterprise audit workstation with the clarity and fluid responsiveness of a modern data-dense desktop application.
keyCharacteristics: High information density without visual crowding.
Purpose-driven semantic coloring (Green = Met, Amber = Partial, Red = Missed).
Multi-tier layouts guiding attention from high-level executive KPIs down to individual staff records.
Deterministic keyboard accelerators (1-7 timeframes, S snapshots).

rules.name: The Rarity Rule
rules.body: The primary indigo accent is reserved strictly for active interactive controls and primary KPIs. It never covers more than 8% of the viewport area.

rules.name: The Functional Color Rule
rules.body: Green, red, and amber are reserved exclusively for compliance statuses, completion calculations, and destructive warnings.

rules.name: The Flat-at-Rest Rule
rules.body: All cards and panels sit flat on the slate canvas. Elevation exists solely as a response to user focus or hover state.

dos: Do provide context text under every large KPI metric.
Do use self-contained SVG icons for actions instead of raw emoji glyphs.
Do preserve the 4-tier visual hierarchy on analytics surfaces.
Do support keyboard accelerators on core navigation and modal flows.
donts: Don't use gradient text on headers, titles, or metrics.
Don't use thick colored borders on one side of a card (borderLeft: 5px solid).
Don't leave empty states without actionable guidance when date filters return 0 records.
Don't mix different font families outside Geist and Geist Mono.
